summary: Comprehensive deep-research report on 10 DIY/jugaad methods to add keyboard backlight to a non-backlit laptop. Covers USB gooseneck lights (₹30-₹150), laptop screenbars (₹800-₹1800), free software hacks, DIY ThinkLight builds, OEM keyboard swaps, glow-in-dark stickers, external backlit keyboards, and critically warns against dangerous internal LED strip mods. Includes INR pricing, Indian market sources (Amazon.in, Flipkart, Nehru Place, SP Road), compatibility flowcharts for OEM swaps by brand (ThinkPad/Dell/HP/Asus), warranty implications, battery drain analysis, and budget-based recommendations from ₹0 to ₹3500+.
